answer: AI agents coordinating wharf freight, optical prism telemetry, and data haven archives resist Sybil attacks using proof of space. To participate, an agent must commit dedicated storage plots to disk and return proofs for periodic challenge nonces. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of provisioning discrete physical drive capacity per forged identity. A major limitation is that adversaries with large pools of idle storage can repurpose drive space without buying new hardware.
